Healthy, cooling, filling & gut-friendly breakfast! Probiotic-rich, packed with iron, calcium, fiber & essential nutrients—perfect for weight loss & digestion ❤️ Light, satisfying & ideal for all ages, especially in summer ✨ Recipe: 🌿 Mix 2 tbsp ragi flour with 1 cup water to make a smooth slurry. In a pan, heat 2 cups water. Once it starts boiling, add the slurry and cook on medium flame till it thickens. Keep stirring continuously to avoid lumps. Let it cool completely. 🌿 In a bowl, add 1 cup fresh curd, 2–3 cups water, salt to taste, ¼ cup finely chopped onion, and 2 tbsp coriander leaves. Add the cooled ragi porridge and mix well. 🌿 Prepare the tadka: heat 1 tsp oil or ghee, add ½ tsp cumin seeds + mustard seeds, grated ginger, green chili, curry leaves, and a pinch of hing. Pour over the kanji. Enjoy! #ragimillet #raagikanji  #guthealth #healthybreakfast #milletrecipes

🇨🇭MOUNT RIGI SWITZERLAND TRAVEL GUIDE⬇️ Save for your Switzerland travel trip and if Mount Rigi Switzerland isn’t already on your Switzerland travel itinerary, add it now! Here’s my travel guide for visiting Mt. Rigi the "Queen of the Mountains." Mount Rigi near Lucerne, Switzerland is home to Europe’s oldest mountain railway so getting to the summit by cogwheel train is half the magic. 🚂How to get to Mount Rigi - all completely FREE with your Swiss Travel Pass! ➡️ From Lucerne: boat across Lake Lucerne to Vitznau, then cogwheel train to the top in just 30 minutes ➡️ From Zurich: train to Arth-Goldau, then cogwheel train to Rigi Kulm in under an hour 🚠 Or take the cable car from Weggis to Rigi Kaltbad in just 10 minutes 🗺️ Check the online timetables before you go 🛏️ Where to stay on Mount Rigi Check into @hotelrigikaltbad 1,450m above sea level, with panoramic mountain views and a mineral spa fed straight from the mountain springs. Day passes to the spa are available, but nothing beats an early morning on Mt. Rigi waking up above the clouds, hearing cowbells at sunrise, and finishing with a dip in the mineral water. ✨Things to do on Mount Rigi 🇨🇭Visit the summit Rigi Kulm 🇨🇭Hike the Lake Views Trail from Rigi Kulm to Rigi Staffelhöhe 🇨🇭 Lunch at Michelin-starred Regina Montium @kraeuterhoteledelweiss 🇨🇭 Catch sunset at the Känzeli viewpoint 🇨🇭 Soak in mountain views from every angle 🇨🇭 Dip in the mineral spa at @mineralbadrigikaltbad Your ultimate Mount Rigi Switzerland travel guide - save it, share it, and add it to your Switzerland bucket list! 🏔️ Filmed on an ad-press trip  ———————————————— Rigi, Mt Rigi, Mount Rigi, Mount Rigi Switzerland, Lucerne, Luzern, Lucerne Switzerland, Lucerne food, bucket list, food bucket list, viral food, content creator, travel Switzerland, travel blog, travel foodie, travel in Europe, visit Switzerland, my Switzerland, best places to visit in Switzerland, Switzerland mountain, Michelin Star restaurant, Lucerne restaurants, things to do Lucerne #switzerland  #lucerne #rigi #travelswitzerland #luzern
